image_description: A young girl with curly hair is blowing a soap bubble using a pink wand. A large, clear soap bubble is visible floating to her left. She is wearing a white patterned shirt and holding the wand near her mouth. A yellow bottle of bubble solution sits in the lower right corner. The background consists of dark wooden planks.
